title: AW27 Women's Category Opportunities
summary: Growth for AW27 women: coats (double-faced and technical), skirt suits, velvet and lace evening-to-day, marl knits and fine merino.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Boland sees the upper body widening (80s shoulders, broad chests) over narrower trousers or skirts; key items include the skirt suit, broad-shouldered and reversible double-faced coats, camouflage parka and marl jumper<sup>[1]</sup>
- Citywear suitings hide waterproof, breathable or windproof membranes, three-layer constructions and bi-stretch, so a jacket looks like a classic suit while performing like technical wear<sup>[2]</sup>
- The Première Vision selection came out "silkier and more influenced by eveningwear codes" than expected: satins, crushed velvets and wool blends<sup>[2]</sup>
- Première Vision links demand for softness, flexibility and ease to an ageing customer who still wants elegance<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Opportunities
sections.body:
1. Coats.
2. Skirt suits and blazers.
3. Velvet and lace day-to-evening.
4. Fine merino layering.
5. Comfort-led elegance for older customers.

sections.heading: Reduce
sections.body: Pure black basics; heavy synthetic outerwear.

design_implications: - Shift development to coats and suits.
